== Summary ==
[[Werlindo Mangrobang]], headshot from his personal website. Photographer: unknown. Reduced to 400 × 443 px from the 1800 × 1994 px original.

== Source ==
* [https://werlindo.com/ Werlindo Mangrobang], personal website (retrieved 27 October 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027202019/https://werlindo.com/ Internet Archive]. Image: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027201923/https://werlindo.com/img/headshot.png headshot.png] (Wayback 27 October 2026; SHA-256 e1d6c72ecbd9f8ad891cf8398fe2cd9f198f53aa0a087d458d5c2c6cc3e54bd7, matching the live file).
* Match: the name is distinctive, and the 1997 Dagobah Contest winner of that name came from Federal Way, Washington.

== Fair use rationale ==
* '''Purpose:''' identifies the subject of the article [[Werlindo Mangrobang]].
* '''Portion used:''' the whole image, reduced in size.
* '''Replaceability:''' no free photograph of him is known.
* '''Market effect:''' a small, non-commercial copy on a fan encyclopedia does not replace any commercial use.
* '''Copyright:''' the photographer or Werlindo Mangrobang. Used under fair use for identification only.
